svg.title: How starcubes works
svg.desc: A source — a SQL database or a log file — is read incrementally on a high watermark by a three-stage ETL engine, which loads a compact star schema into Postgres. The chart and alarms read that schema; filters live in the URL.

svg.text: Point it at a source once — every question after that is a click.
